title: Forensic Evidence Metadata
description: Standardized schema for forensic evidence data stored on IPFS

caseId.description: The unique identifier for the police case.

officerId.description: Badge number or ID of the registering officer.

registrationTimestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of when the evidence was acquired.

location.description: GPS coordinates or description of where the evidence was found.

description.description: Brief description of the evidence item.

fileCid.description: The IPFS Content Identifier (CID) for the actual evidence file.

fileMimeType.description: MIME type of the evidence file (e.g., image/jpeg).
